info.title: OEC Registry – MQTT interface
info.description: The MQTT interface of the OEC Registry D5 (ADR-0029 §8): the Registry services of MG A1 (REQ-REG-002), the interface of an application of Messaging Level 3 served by the SDK on its own AppId (its lifecycle MG 6.3, Get of every resource, Set and Del of the writable ones, its own Config `registry`, a persistent ReferenceDesignation, Call/NewDataSetWriterId) and the subscriptions and read-only Get requests it uses to collect the MAM, Health, Profile, Events, PublicationList and SubscriptionList of the participants and the last value of their Data (REQ-REG-001, ADR-0008, ADR-0029 §4). Increment 2 (C-087). Payloads are the NetworkMessages of the OEC JSON Schema D1, referenced by their $id.
